snippet.title: Summer for ANT - Collect All the Food Before Winter - Steam Next Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
Winter is coming; gather the food scattered around. A cozy job simulator where you play as an ANT. The colony needs calories, and you're their only hope. Lead your colony, hire other ants, unlock upgrades, and collect all the food in 8 different areas to make the summer a breeze!

Wishlist now & Play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5162770/Summer_for_ANT/
